j_latent.source_representation: the frozen backbone being audited (A3/A4: frozen full-10k checkpoint; B: the corresponding Fit8k backbone)

nulls.j_raw_null: permute bond_type within molecule, preserving histogram; SeedSequence([20261026, molecule_index])
nulls.j_latent_null: permute c_loc rows within molecule, preserving multiset; SeedSequence([20261026, molecule_index])
nulls.disclosure: bond-type reassignment may break chemical valence; it is an information control, not a legal molecule

b_phase.allocation: within stratum sort by sha256(content_key), 80/10/10 with largest remainder to exact totals
